top_reviews.title: Brightening Without Irritation
top_reviews.body: I’ve been using the EOQUALBERRY Vitamin Illuminating Serum for a few weeks now, and I’m really happy with it. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or greasy.I like that it combines niacinamide and vitamin C. My skin looks a little brighter and more even, and it feels smoother overall. I haven’t experienced any irritation, which is important for me.It layers well with moisturizer and sunscreen, so it fits easily into my daily routine. A small amount goes a long way.Overall, a great serum if you’re looking for something gentle that still gives visible results. Value for the money

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on February 24, 2026

top_reviews.title: Subtle and Slow Results
top_reviews.body: I've been using this serum for a little while now and have just about finished the bottle. I like that it's a very gentle, non-irritating formula. It doesn't have a scent and it absorbs into my skin really quickly without leaving a sticky feel. I've been applying it consistently to see how it handles discoloration, especially on my elbows.The serum does brighten and lighten dark spots, but I've noticed it happens very slowly. It isn't nearly as dramatic as the results shown in the advertisements. You really have to stay on top of using it every day to see any progress. While I think it works fine for general brightening, I was hoping for something with a bit more strength for tougher areas like my dark elbows. Based on the campaign ads and social media hype, I expected much stronger results in brightening and softening.It's a nice product to use because of how well it sinks in, but it just didn't give me the level of results I was looking for. Since I want something more powerful for lightening, I probably won't repurchase this one anytime soon. I'm going to keep trying different products until I find something that works a bit faster on those stubborn spots.
